title: Flow Cytometer Fluorescence Voltration for FCMPASS
author: Joshua A Welsh

steps.title: Vortex bead stock
steps.instruction: Vortex the 8‑peak rainbow beads (SpheroTech) bottle on a high setting for 00:00:05.

steps.title: Prepare DPBS and bead tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 500 µL of DPBS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Catalog #14190144) into two 5 mL round‑bottom tubes (Corning, Catalog #352052). Label one tube “DPBS” and the other “Beads”. Use standard (non‑low‑protein‑binding) tubes to avoid excess unbound fluor that raises background noise.

steps.title: Add beads to tube and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 3 drops of the 8‑peak rainbow beads (SpheroTech) to the “Beads” 5 mL round‑bottom tube (Corning, Catalog #352052) and vortex for 00:00:05.

steps.title: Check cytometer settings
steps.instruction: Ensure the cytometer is clean, that –Height and –Area statistics are set to be collected on all parameters, and that all parameters are turned on.

steps.title: Create pseudocolor scatter plot
steps.instruction: Create a pseudocolor plot with FSC‑A on the X‑axis and (488 nm) B‑SSC‑A on the Y‑axis; plot both parameters on a linear scale.

steps.title: Create histogram of violet SSC
steps.instruction: Create a histogram plot with (405 nm) V‑SSC‑H on the X‑axis and display it on a log scale.

steps.title: Set trigger threshold and gains
steps.instruction:
Set the cytometer triggering threshold to (405 nm) V‑SSC‑H. Acquire all samples at the lowest flow rate (≈10–15 µL min⁻¹). Use the following guide values (adjust as needed):
- Beckman Coulter CytoFLEX (405 nm OD0, 488 nm OD2): Threshold V‑SSC‑H = 1000; V‑SSC Gain = 200; FSC Gain = 100; B‑SSC Gain = 100.
- Cytek Bioscience Aurora (405 nm OD0, 488 nm OD2): Threshold V‑SSC‑H = 1000; V‑SSC Gain = 600; FSC Gain = 70; B‑SSC Gain = 70.

steps.title: Acquire DPBS tube and set noise floor
steps.instruction: Acquire the “DPBS” tube while viewing the histogram from step 6. Adjust detector gain or trigger threshold until instrument noise is acquired at ~1000 events s⁻¹ (distinct sharp peak). No data recording is required for this step; it is only to identify optimal settings.

steps.title: Acquire beads tube and adjust scatter gains
steps.instruction: Acquire the “Beads” tube (step 3). Using the pseudocolor plot from step 5, adjust FSC and B‑SSC gains until the single‑bead population is clearly resolved from the doublet population (top‑right). Apply the violet SSC trigger settings identified in step 8.

steps.title: Gate single‑bead population
steps.instruction: Create a gate around the single‑bead population and name it “Gate 1”.

steps.title: Set event collection target
steps.instruction: Adjust the instrument’s stopping criteria to record until 10,000 events are acquired within “Gate 1”.

steps.title: Perform fluorescence voltration
steps.instruction: Record the “Beads” tube at multiple fluorescent detector gain settings while keeping the trigger threshold and light‑scatter gains constant. Acquire at least 10 different gain settings (e.g., 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000). For cytometers with avalanche photodiodes, use finer increments at lower gains; for photomultiplier‑tube instruments, space gains evenly. Refer to the provided Acquisition Template.xlsx for example settings.

steps.title: Verify brightest bead visibility
steps.instruction: Confirm that the brightest bead is visible on at least two of the selected gain settings to ensure accurate downstream data analysis.
